nodes.label: Record Access Control
nodes.rationale: The report finds no application identity or permission checks, so knowledge of an ID suffices to view a record in the current code.

nodes.label: MVC Architecture
nodes.rationale: Controllers coordinate requests, models hold data and rules, and views render HTML.

nodes.label: Model Validation
nodes.rationale: Model::load assigns safe attributes but does not itself validate or save them.

nodes.label: Static Cookie Validation Key
nodes.rationale: The tracked web.php contains a fixed cookie validation key.

nodes.label: Sensitive Log Context
nodes.rationale: Default FileTarget context includes request and cookie globals that may contain sensitive data.

nodes.label: Patient Field Format Validation
nodes.rationale: Invalid national code, phone number, and future birth date passed model validation without a save.

nodes.label: Quantity Overflow Validation
nodes.rationale: Quantity 4294967296 passed validation although the database unsigned int maximum is 4294967295.

nodes.label: Unique Patient Race
nodes.rationale: UniqueValidator lookup and INSERT are separate; the database UNIQUE constraint remains the final guard.

nodes.label: Unbounded Dropdown Queries
nodes.rationale: Patient and admission dropdowns load all records; search uses leading wildcards and uncapped tokens.

nodes.label: Missing Identity and Authorization
nodes.rationale: No project-specific User identity, AccessControl, or authManager is present.

nodes.label: Queries in Views
nodes.rationale: Forms and summary views query the database and repeat display calculations.

nodes.label: Hidden Table Overflow
nodes.rationale: site.css overflow:hidden overrides Bootstrap responsive table horizontal scrolling.

nodes.label: Prior HTTP Tests Missing
nodes.rationale: The prior WORK_REPORT describes 38 HTTP checks, but their tools are no longer in the repository and were not all rerun for this report.

nodes.label: Historical Unit Price
nodes.rationale: AdmissionService.unit_price preserves the price at the time of registration; totals use it rather than the current Service.price.

nodes.label: Database Install SQL
nodes.rationale: The project has database/install.sql but no Yii migration classes or console entry point.

nodes.label: Admissions Row Lock
nodes.rationale: Both sensitive writers lock the parent admissions row before checking status or changing data.

nodes.label: Database Transaction
nodes.rationale: Service registration and discharge use transactions to keep related writes consistent.

nodes.label: Database DDL Privileges
nodes.rationale: The runtime database account has DDL grants in the examined environment.

nodes.label: Legacy Zero Admission Dates
nodes.rationale: Three existing admission_date values were zero dates; current inserts use NOW().

nodes.label: Preview Total Drift
nodes.rationale: GET preview has no lock, while POST recomputes the total inside its transaction.

nodes.label: Zero Description Hidden
nodes.rationale: PHP ?: treats string 0 as false in the admission summary view.

nodes.label: Database Backup and Recovery Verification

nodes.label: Fresh Database Installation
nodes.rationale: install.sql is intended for an empty database and is not an upgrade script for an existing database.

nodes.label: Service Price Snapshot
nodes.rationale: The service unit price is stored at registration so later tariff changes do not change historical charges.

nodes.label: Database and Project Scope Cleanup
nodes.rationale: Users, doctors, wards and their separate management pages were removed to match the one-operator project scope while preserving core records and historical names.
